Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency and cost profile looked promising for our use case. Our leadership asked me to share a short Mutual Action Plan and to flag a commercial ask up front: given we can commit to a 3-month evaluation that scales to a longer enterprise pilot (target: 3.5M tokens/month by month 3 and a roadmap to full production thereafter), would Redwood consider a 25% first-year discount on hosted inference pricing?

I've attached a MAP draft with milestones (discovery, evaluation, security review, pilot ramp, legal). Procurement would need a pricing anchor and SOM (Statement of Milestones) to move us onto a platform trial.

Attachments: Catalyst_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft)

Can you confirm whether that level of concession is within play and what approval path we should expect?

Jordan

- Catalyst is a strategic logos-profile account (good reference potential).
- Their ramp plan (3.5M tokens/mo by month 3) is ambitious but plausible.
- Pricing ask: 25% off first-year list is outside standard AE strike; we can consider a tiered concession (20% up-front + performance rebate tied to ramp milestones).

2) Evelyn — if we need to go beyond 20% (or structure rebates), finance will need to confirm acceptable gross margin and payment terms.

Evelyn — short summary and ask:

- Customer: Catalyst Insights (potential strategic reference).
- Ask: 25% first-year discount on hosted inference pricing, contingent on 3-month eval transitioning to enterprise pilot (3.5M tokens/mo by month 3).
- Proposed commercial structure (Lauren's suggestion): 20% upfront + 0–5% ramp-backed rebate (paid quarterly) conditional on hit rates at month 2 and month 3.
- Expected ARR if they convert: ~USD 360k first-year with staged ramp; downside if they churn after pilot is limited due to trial structure.

Requesting finance review: can we approve a 20% concession at AE/manager level, or do we require CFO/Executive sign-off to move forward? If the customer insists on 25% up-front, we'll need an executive exception and CEO acknowledgement.

If you need the math I'm attaching a quick impact model.

Subject: Re: Catalyst MAP — pricing ask and finance review

Thanks for the summary. I reviewed the attached model. Finance position:

- We can approve up to a 20% concession at the manager/VP level provided there is a signed SOM with clear milestones and payment timing (net 30/45 and quarterly true-ups for rebates).
- Anything beyond 20% (i.e., 21–25% up-front) materially impacts our target first-year gross margin and needs an executive exception.

Please loop in Vivek for >20% approvals. If they want the full 25% now, we should ask for: 12-month minimum term commitment or a revenue guarantee to offset the concession.

Evelyn Hart
Head of Finance (Interim CFO)

From: evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Exec approval required: Catalyst discount escalation

Vivek — quick ask. Catalyst is requesting 25% first-year discount tied to a 3-month ramping pilot (target 3.5M tokens/month). Finance is comfortable up to 20% with SOM and payment protections. To approve 25% we recommend either:

1) 12-month minimum contractual commitment OR
2) 25% up-front limited to first 6 months with a make-whole if they don't hit ramp, OR
3) Approve 25% but require an upfront non-refundable onboarding fee to preserve economics.

Aditya and Lauren support a hybrid approach (20% up-front + additional 5% as ramp rebate), which limits immediate margin impact but delivers to the customer's ask. If you can green-light 22–25% with one of the protections above, we'll finalize SOM and legal will prep the SOW/contract.

-Evelyn

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Exec approval required: Catalyst discount escalation

Thanks — I agree with a conservative, measurable compromise. Approve the following:

- Offer 22% up-front discount off list for year one.
- Additional 3% back-loaded ramp rebate (paid at the end of Q1) if Catalyst meets the agreed token ramp milestones in month 2 and month 3.
- Require a 6-month minimum commitment (payable net 30) and a non-refundable onboarding fee equal to one month of expected spend at list pricing.

Conditions: include clear acceptance criteria in the SOW and pre-authorize legal to include a clause for make-whole if they materially miss ramp milestones and then cancel. With those protections, finance is comfortable. Please document in HubSpot and get a DocuSign SOM.

Approved — Vivek
CEO, Redwood Inference

1) Pricing: 22% off list for year one.
2) Ramp rebate: up to +3% (so total potential concession equals 25%) paid at the end of Q1 if month-2 and month-3 token targets are met per the MAP.
3) Commitment: 6-month minimum term, payable net 30.
4) Onboarding: non-refundable onboarding fee equal to one month of list-priced spend.
5) Acceptance: detailed SOW acceptance criteria to be included in DocuSign.

I've created a HubSpot deal and uploaded the SOW stub and impact model (links below). Legal will send a DocuSign SOM reflecting the above this afternoon. If this looks good, can procurement review and confirm the payment cadence so Legal can generate the agreement?
